title: Contract-event records (0x0008) version 3: the board's relayed-ballot and close-statement events
generator: packages/crypto/scripts/contract-event-v3-vectors.py: an independent Python implementation of docs/spec/contracts.md (Contract-event record, Event tables (version 3)) and of docs/spec/close.md's strict decoding of a close statement, over contract-event-v2-vectors.py's framing and version-2 check; ballots from ballot.json and ballot-v2.json, relay call fields from relay.json, close statements from close-statement.json, and every record of contract-event-v2.json re-checked
